FOREWORD This Indian Standard (Part 3/Set 406 ) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on 25 October 1989, after the draft finalized by the Solid Electrical Insulating Meterials Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council. This standard deals with flexible insulating and general of tests, and for individual types of sleevings. for glass textile sleeving with PVC based coating high for 2 ) : sleevings. It consists of the following three parts;

Part 1 Definitions Part 2 Methods

requirements,

Part 3 Specifications

This standard covers the requirements ~breakdown strength.

This standard should be read in conjunction with IS 11654 (Part 1 ) : 1986 `Specification flexible insulating sleeving: Part 1 Definitions and general requirements' and IS 11654 ( Part 1986 `Specification for 6exible insulating sleeving: Part 2 Methods of test'.

In the preparation of this standard; assistance has been derived from IEC Dot : 15C ( Central Office ) 199, Sheet 406 glass textile sleeving with PVC based coating high breakdown strength, issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission ( IEC ). Stand rrd Mark The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of the Bureau of ;Indian Standards Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The Standard Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by BIS and operated by the producer. Standard marked products are also continuously checked by BIS for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards.
